person_words: All of our competitors are launching AI features. Our current development team have been working on them and is enthusiastic about continuing to develop them. However, management has just told me that we need to launch at least our basic AI chat integration within the next two months. The team doesn't think they can do this, mainly because they lack experience developing AI. I need to find a way to hit this deadline.
Why doesn't the model have any risks at all?
But you haven't added any risks, as I asked you to. What's going on?
